item.title: Court to rule on El-Rufai’s bail application March 31
item.description: A Federal High Court sitting in Kaduna State has adjourned proceedings on the bail application of former Governor Nasir El-Rufai to March 31, 2026. This comes after Tuesday’s hearing, during which legal arguments were presented by both the prosecution and the defense. Counsel to the defendant, Ukpon Akpan urged the court to grant his client bail, citing constitutional rights and the need to allow the former governor adequate time to prepare his defense. item.title: 2027 Elections: INEC Unveils Updated Guidelines, Regulations for Political Parties

item.title: APC Controls 31 States, ADC Poses No Threat – Nasarawa Gov Sule
